tagline: Under Virginia's highest mountain, west to the trail town.
intro: Route 603 runs 13.2 miles west from Troutdale to Konnarock through the Mount Rogers National Recreation Area, which holds Mount Rogers, at 5,729 feet the highest point in Virginia. The line drawn here also follows Route 16 north from Troutdale, up to Dickey Gap on the Tennessee Valley Divide and down the other side to Sugar Grove.
The byway's other half, 32.5 miles of US 58 east from Damascus to Volney, is not drawn on this map. Taken as a loop, the two halves run about 60 miles.

moments.title: Ripshin Farm
moments.text: East of Troutdale, Sherwood Anderson bought this small farm in 1925, lived in a log cabin while his house went up, and finished Dark Laughter, his only bestseller, here.

moments.title: Konnarock
moments.text: The Lutheran girls' school here, a church mission to the southern Appalachians, put up its main building in 1925, sheathed in bark shingles, and closed in 1958.

moments.title: Damascus
moments.text: Five trails meet in Trail Town USA, the Appalachian Trail and the Virginia Creeper among them, and the Trail Days festival each May is the largest gathering of Appalachian Trail hikers anywhere.
